level_anchors: {"1":"Starts the next action with breath, eyes or base still broken.","2":"Restores breath, eyes and base before the next action, but decision quality lags; or restores all four only after a coach cue.","3":"Restores breath, eyes, base and decision quality before the next action, without a cue."}

name: Chase control.
level_anchors: {"1":"Chases: follows the partner's movement with urgency, hand-led, and the structure breaks.","2":"Mostly controlled, but chases at least once in the set: the hands lead and the shape slips, then recovers.","3":"Does not chase: follows or cuts off movement with the feet and the structure intact, hands not leading."}

name: Composure under disruption.
level_anchors: {"1":"After a disruption (contact, clinch, crowding, a timing break), shape or decisions break down and do not recover in the rep.","2":"Stays usable after a disruption but with a visible lapse (a late, rushed or skipped decision), then recovers.","3":"Stays usable and decision-capable through the disruption: shape and decisions hold."}
field_labels: {"level_anchors":{"basis":"Built on the glossary: 'Composure = the ability to stay usable and decision-capable under pressure, contact, error, or delay.' and 'Disruption = any event that breaks normal rhythm or shape, such as contact, clinch, interruption, crowding, or timing breaks.'","draft":"AI draft, lane CAT-d, 2026-11-17 (OD-2026-11-16-003 rulings 2 and 3; OD-2026-11-15-011)","sources":["trk_1f8e1d681bb3ae (DOC-027 glossary)","DOC-041"],"status":"INFERRED"},"name":{"basis":"DOC-041 Core Drill KPIs Worth Scoring, quoted","sources":["DOC-041"],"status":"OBSERVED"},"scoring_kind":{"basis":"A quality, scored in three levels; DOC-027 tracks a 'Composure rating.'","draft":"AI draft, lane CAT-d, 2026-11-17 (OD-2026-11-16-003 rulings 2 and 3; OD-2026-11-15-011)","sources":["DOC-041","DOC-027"],"status":"INFERRED"}}
